meta.name: Human
meta.description:
Paleoanthropologist Ella Al-Shamahi reveals humanity's incredible story across 300,000 years of human evolution – and how the story is stranger and more surprising than ever imagined.

Ended · First aired 14 Jul 2025 · United Kingdom · Language: English · 59 min
Studio: BBC Studios Science Unit, NOVA · Network: BBC Two

Complete series. On your server: S1 5/5

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: The First of Us
videos.overview: The extraordinary story of how the human species, Homo sapiens, first emerged, where the discoveries of recent years are revolutionising the understanding of humanity's origin story.

videos.title: Into the Unknown
videos.overview: Following early Homo sapiens's ancestors as they step out of Africa and venture into the wider world, heading into areas inhabited by other human species.

videos.title: Last Humans Standing
videos.overview: Shocking new insights into the demise of modern humans' sister species, the Neanderthals, Homo sapiens's possible role in their downfall and how it become the last human species on Earth.

videos.title: Discovering the Americas
videos.overview: During the height of the Ice Age, one of the coldest times humanity has ever known, Homo sapiens steps into the last habitable continents on the planet: the Americas.

videos.title: A Great Gamble
videos.overview: Around 12,000 years ago, as the Ice Age finally thaws, humanity makes a dramatic shift - abandoning nomadic life for permanent settlements.

meta.slogan: The most extraordinary story of all... Our own.
